router_balance_nonzero.meaning: the TrailsRouter contract holds a non-zero ERC20 or ETH balance

inject_and_call_public_no_guard.meaning: injectAndCall is public and lacks an onlyDelegatecall guard, so it can be invoked directly

attacker_target_available.meaning: a target contract of the attacker's choosing exists that can consume the router's balance

direct_call_spends_router_funds.meaning: an arbitrary external caller directly calling injectAndCall causes the router's own held ERC20/ETH balance to be spent

assumptions: The router may hold ERC20 tokens or ETH at the time of the direct call (as_router_holds_funds).
The attacker-controlled target can invoke transferFrom(msg.sender, ...) to consume the router's balance.
The direct call resolves address(this) to the router and _getSelfBalance to the router's own balance.

unresolved.description: The report does not establish that the router actually held a non-zero balance at any observed time; the balance is stated conditionally.
The exact approve/call sequence of _injectAndExecuteCall is not fully specified, so the precise spending mechanism is not formalized.

limitations: Only the direct impact i_router_funds_spent is formalized; i_drain_single_call is deferred to a future claim.
The drain is described as a capability, not an observed on-chain event.
Code/PoC binding and concrete balance values are deferred.
